title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases | TechCrunch
summary: Unlike Gemini’s Chat, which merely allows users to talk to Google’s AI assistant for informational purposes, Tasks empowers the app to complete basic secretarial functions, deputizing it as a kind of personal assistant.
